newsitem.title: INDIA: GAIL invites global bids for India LNG terminal.
newsitem.headline: GAIL invites global bids for India LNG terminal.

text.p: The state-run Gas Authority of India Ltd (GAIL) on Tuesday invited international bids from consultants to make a detailed feasibility report for building a liquified natural gas (LNG) terminal on the southern coast.
The LNG terminal is to come up at Ennore Port, which is being developed as a satellite port of Madras, a major port on the eastern coast.
The terminal will have a capacity to handle 2.5 million tonnes of imported LNG a year, GAIL said.
It said bidders should have experience in construction and commissioning of LNG terminals, LNG receiving jetties, storage and regassification facilities.
In July, U.K. based oil analyst Wood Mackenzie said by 2010, India would be importing about 12 billion cubic metres of LNG.
